name: PsExec/SMBExec execution
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5140 and ShareName == 'ADMIN$' and RelativeTargetName contains 'PSEXESVC' | or (DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'psexec.exe')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5140 ShareName=ADMIN$ RelativeTargetName=*PSEXESVC OR index=windows Image=*\\psexec.exe
tuning: org standard = allowlist sysadmin hosts; unknown psexec = immediate investigation.
